def match_to_datetime(match: re.Match[str]) -> datetime | date:
    """Convert a `RE_DATETIME` match to `datetime.datetime` or `datetime.date`.

    Raises ValueError if the match does not correspond to a valid date
    or datetime.
    """
    (
        year_str,
        month_str,
        day_str,
        hour_str,
        minute_str,
        sec_str,
        micros_str,
        zulu_time,
        offset_sign_str,
        offset_hour_str,
        offset_minute_str,
    ) = match.groups()
    year, month, day = int(year_str), int(month_str), int(day_str)
    if hour_str is None:
        return date(year, month, day)
    hour, minute = int(hour_str), int(minute_str)
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
    micros = int(micros_str.ljust(6, "0")) if micros_str else 0
    if offset_sign_str:
        tz: tzinfo | None = cached_tz(
            offset_hour_str, offset_minute_str, offset_sign_str
        )
    elif zulu_time:
        tz = timezone.utc
    else:  # local date-time
        tz = None
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, sec, micros, tzinfo=tz)

def match_to_localtime(match: re.Match[str]) -> time:
    hour_str, minute_str, sec_str, micros_str = match.groups()
    sec = int(sec_str) if sec_str else 0
    micros = int(micros_str.ljust(6, "0")) if micros_str else 0

        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)

        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is True

    def test_pending_flags(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.add_pending(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST)
        # not applied yet
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
        f.finalize_pending()
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True
        # pending cleared
        f._pending_flags.add(("b", Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST))
        # second finalize applies only new one
        assert f.is_(("b",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_unset_all(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True
        f.unset_all(("a", "b"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_unset_all_missing_path_noop(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.unset_all(("x", "y", "z"))  # no error

    def test_unset_all_keeps_other_flags(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)
        f.unset_all(("a", "b"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

class TestFlags:
    def test_empty_key_is_never_set(self):
        f = Flags()
        assert f.is_((), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_set_empty_key_raises(self):
        f = Flags()
        with pytest.raises(IndexError):
            f.set((), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)

    def test_set_and_is(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_missing_key(self):
        f = Flags()
        assert f.is_(("x", "y"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_recursive_flag_applies_to_children(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.FROZEN) is True
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is True
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is True

    def test_nonrecursive_does_not_apply_to_children(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_recursive_mid_path(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is True

    def test_recursive_at_stem_does_not_hide_other_flag(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is True

    def test_nonrecursive_at_stem_not_applied_to_descendant(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is True
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_pending_flags(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.add_pending(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST)
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
        f.finalize_pending()
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True
        f._pending_flags.add(("b", Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST))
        assert f.is_(("b",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_finalize_pending_clears_set(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.add_pending(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST)
        f.finalize_pending()
        assert f._pending_flags == set()

    def test_pending_applied_non_recursive(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.add_pending(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST)
        f.finalize_pending()
        # non-recursive -> descendants not flagged
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_unset_all(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True
        f.unset_all(("a", "b"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_unset_all_missing_path_noop(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.unset_all(("x", "y", "z"))

    def test_unset_all_keeps_other_flags(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)
        f.unset_all(("a", "b"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_unset_all_missing_stem_of_existing_parent(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        f.unset_all(("a", "zzz"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True

    def test_unset_all_nested_recursive_flag_remains(self):
        f = Flags()
        # unset_all removes the entire subtree under stem
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        f.unset_all(("a", "b"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_skip_comment_at_eof_index(self):

        # All three are prepended in msg, doc, pos order.
        with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):
            err = TOMLDecodeError(msg="M", doc="D", pos="P")
        assert args_of(err) == ("M", "D", "P")


def args_of(err):
    return err.args

class TestFlags:
    def test_empty_key_is_never_set(self):
        f = Flags()
        assert f.is_((), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_set_empty_key_raises(self):
        f = Flags()
        with pytest.raises(IndexError):
            f.set((), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)

    def test_set_and_is(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_missing_key(self):
        f = Flags()
        assert f.is_(("x", "y"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_recursive_flag_applies_to_children(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.FROZEN) is True
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is True
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is True

    def test_nonrecursive_does_not_apply_to_children(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_recursive_mid_path(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is True

    def test_recursive_at_stem_does_not_hide_other_flag(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is True

    def test_nonrecursive_at_stem_not_applied_to_descendant(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is True
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_pending_flags(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.add_pending(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST)
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
        f.finalize_pending()
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True
        f._pending_flags.add(("b", Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST))
        assert f.is_(("b",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_finalize_pending_clears_set(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.add_pending(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST)
        f.finalize_pending()
        assert f._pending_flags == set()

    def test_pending_applied_non_recursive(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.add_pending(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST)
        f.finalize_pending()
        # non-recursive -> descendants not flagged
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_unset_all(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True
        f.unset_all(("a", "b"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_unset_all_missing_path_noop(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.unset_all(("x", "y", "z"))

    def test_unset_all_keeps_other_flags(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)
        f.unset_all(("a", "b"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_unset_all_missing_stem_of_existing_parent(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        f.unset_all(("a", "zzz"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True

    def test_unset_all_nested_recursive_flag_remains(self):
        f = Flags()
        # unset_all removes the entire subtree under stem
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        f.unset_all(("a", "b"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_lineno_counts_only_before_pos(self):
        # positions after a newline should not count newline at/after pos
        doc = "ab\ncd\nef"
        err = TOMLDecodeError("x", doc, 4)  # 'd'
        assert err.lineno == 2
        assert err.colno == 2

    def test_lineno_pos_at_newline(self):
        doc = "ab\ncd"
        # pos 2 is the '\n' itself; count(0,2) does not include it
        err = TOMLDecodeError("x", doc, 2)
        assert err.lineno == 1
        assert err.colno == 3

    def test_colno_uses_rindex(self):
        # rindex must find the *last* newline before pos, not the first
        doc = "a\nb\nc"
        err = TOMLDecodeError("x", doc, 4)  # 'c' on line 3
        assert err.lineno == 3
        assert err.colno == 1

    def test_end_of_document(self):
        doc = "abc"
        err = TOMLDecodeError("x", doc, 3)
        assert str(err) == "x (at end of document)"
        assert err.lineno == 1
        assert err.colno == 4

    def test_pos_beyond_len_is_end_of_document(self):
        err = TOMLDecodeError("x", "abc", 100)
        assert str(err) == "x (at end of document)"

    def test_attributes_set(self):
        err = TOMLDecodeError("msg", "doc", 0)
        assert err.msg == "msg"
        assert err.doc == "doc"
        assert err.pos == 0

    def test_deprecated_freeform_warns(self):
        with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):
            err = TOMLDecodeError("a", "b", 1, "extra")
        assert args_of(err) == ("a", "b", 1, "extra")

    def test_deprecated_defaults_only_warns(self):
        with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):
            err = TOMLDecodeError()
        assert str(err) == ""

    def test_missing_pos_only_warns(self):
        # msg/doc are valid types but pos is not -> deprecation path
        with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):
            err = TOMLDecodeError("m", "d")
        assert args_of(err) == ("m", "d")

    def test_msg_str_doc_str_pos_not_int(self):
        # pos is a str -> deprecation path even without extra args
        with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):
            err = TOMLDecodeError("m", "d", "p")
        assert args_of(err) == ("m", "d", "p")

    def test_msg_str_doc_not_str_pos_int(self):
        # doc is not str, but pos is int -> still deprecation path
        with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):
            err = TOMLDecodeError("m", 5, 3)
        assert args_of(err) == ("m", 5, 3)

    def test_deprecation_warning_message(self):
        with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning) as record:
            TOMLDecodeError("a", "b", 1, "extra")
        msgs = [str(w.message) for w in record]
        assert any(
            "Free-form arguments for TOMLDecodeError are deprecated." in m
            for m in msgs
        )
        assert any(
            "Please set 'msg' (str), 'doc' (str) and 'pos' (int) arguments only." in m
            for m in msgs
        )

    def test_deprecation_warning_stacklevel(self):
        # stacklevel=2 means the warning's filename is this test's file.
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as record:
            warnings.simplefilter("always")
            TOMLDecodeError("a", "b", 1, "extra")
        assert len(record) == 1
        assert record[0].filename == __file__

    def test_kwargs_signature_no_warning(self):
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error")
            err = TOMLDecodeError(pos=5, doc="d", msg="m")
        assert err.msg == "m"
        assert err.doc == "d"
        assert err.pos == 5

    def test_deprecated_msg_non_str(self):
        with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):
            err = TOMLDecodeError(123, "doc", 2)
        assert args_of(err) == (123, "doc", 2)

    def test_deprecated_ordering_of_args(self):
        # All three are prepended in msg, doc, pos order.
        with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):
            err = TOMLDecodeError(msg="M", doc="D", pos="P")
        assert args_of(err) == ("M", "D", "P")


def args_of(err):
    return err.args

class TestFlags:
    def test_empty_key_is_never_set(self):
        f = Flags()
        assert f.is_((), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_set_empty_key_raises(self):
        f = Flags()
        with pytest.raises(IndexError):
            f.set((), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)

    def test_set_and_is(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_missing_key(self):
        f = Flags()
        assert f.is_(("x", "y"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_recursive_flag_applies_to_children(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.FROZEN) is True
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is True
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is True

    def test_nonrecursive_does_not_apply_to_children(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_recursive_mid_path(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is True

    def test_recursive_at_stem_does_not_hide_other_flag(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is True

    def test_nonrecursive_at_stem_not_applied_to_descendant(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is True
        assert f.is_(("a", "b", "c"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_pending_flags(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.add_pending(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST)
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
        f.finalize_pending()
        assert f.is_(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True
        f._pending_flags.add(("b", Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST))
        assert f.is_(("b",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_finalize_pending_clears_set(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.add_pending(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST)
        f.finalize_pending()
        assert f._pending_flags == set()

    def test_pending_applied_non_recursive(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.add_pending(("a",), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST)
        f.finalize_pending()
        # non-recursive -> descendants not flagged
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_unset_all(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True
        f.unset_all(("a", "b"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False

    def test_unset_all_missing_path_noop(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.unset_all(("x", "y", "z"))

    def test_unset_all_keeps_other_flags(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=False)
        f.unset_all(("a", "b"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.FROZEN) is False

    def test_unset_all_missing_stem_of_existing_parent(self):
        f = Flags()
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        f.unset_all(("a", "zzz"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is True

    def test_unset_all_nested_recursive_flag_remains(self):
        f = Flags()
        # unset_all removes the entire subtree under stem
        f.set(("a",), Flags.FROZEN, recursive=True)
        f.set(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST, recursive=False)
        f.unset_all(("a", "b"))
        assert f.is_(("a", "b"), Flags.EXPLICIT_NEST) is False
